   173→			pointCopy := p
   174→			selectedPoint = &pointCopy
   175→			break
   176→		}
   177→	}
   178→
   179→	if selectedPoint == nil {
   180→		return errors.New("rewind point not found")
   181→	}
   182→
   183→	shortID := selectedPoint.ID
   184→	if len(shortID) > 7 {
   185→		shortID = shortID[:7]
   186→	}
   187→
   188→	// Show what was selected
   189→	switch {
   190→	case selectedPoint.IsLogsOnly:
   191→		// Committed checkpoint - show sha
   192→		fmt.Printf("\nSelected: %s %s\n", shortID, sanitizeForTerminal(selectedPoint.Message))
   193→	case selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint:
   194→		// Task checkpoint - no sha
   195→		fmt.Printf("\nSelected: [Task] %s\n", sanitizeForTerminal(selectedPoint.Message))
   196→	default:
   197→		// Shadow checkpoint - no sha
   198→		fmt.Printf("\nSelected: %s\n", sanitizeForTerminal(selectedPoint.Message))
   199→	}
   200→
   201→	// Handle logs-only points with a sub-choice menu
   202→	if selectedPoint.IsLogsOnly {
   203→		return handleLogsOnlyRewindInteractive(start, *selectedPoint, shortID)
   204→	}
   205→
   206→	// Preview rewind to show warnings about files that will be deleted
   207→	preview, previewErr := start.PreviewRewind(*selectedPoint)
   208→	if previewErr == nil && preview != nil && len(preview.FilesToDelete) > 0 {
   209→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nWarning: The following untracked files will be DELETED:\n")
   210→		for _, f := range preview.FilesToDelete {
   211→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", f)
   212→		}
   213→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\n")
   214→	}
   215→
   216→	// Confirm rewind
   217→	var confirm bool
   218→	description := fmt.Sprintf("This will reset to: %s\nChanges after this point may be lost!", selectedPoint.Message)
   219→	confirmForm := NewAccessibleForm(
   220→		huh.NewGroup(
   221→			huh.NewConfirm().
   222→				Title(fmt.Sprintf("Reset to %s?", shortID)).
   223→				Description(description).
   224→				Value(&confirm),
   225→		),
   226→	)
   227→
   228→	if err := confirmForm.Run(); err != nil {
   229→		return fmt.Errorf("confirmation cancelled: %w", err)
   230→	}
   231→
   232→	if !confirm {
   233→		fmt.Println("Rewind cancelled.")
   234→		return nil
   235→	}
   236→
   237→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   238→	agent, err := getAgent(selectedPoint.Agent)
   239→	if err != nil {
   240→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   241→	}
   242→
   243→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   244→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   245→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   246→
   247→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind started",
   248→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   249→		slog.String("session_id", selectedPoint.SessionID),
   250→		slog.Bool("is_task_checkpoint", selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint),
   251→	)
   252→
   253→	// Perform the rewind using strategy
   254→	if err := start.Rewind(*selectedPoint); err != nil {
   255→		logging.Error(ctx, "rewind failed",
   256→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   257→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   258→		)
   259→		return err //nolint:wrapcheck // already present in codebase
   260→	}
   261→
   262→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind completed",
   263→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   264→	)
   265→
   266→	// Handle transcript restoration differently for task checkpoints
   267→	var sessionID string
   268→	var transcriptFile string
   269→
   270→	if selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   271→		// For task checkpoint: read checkpoint.json to get UUID and truncate transcript
   272→		checkpoint, err := start.GetTaskCheckpoint(*selectedPoint)
   273→		if err != nil {
   274→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to read task checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   275→			return nil
   276→		}
   277→
   278→		sessionID = checkpoint.SessionID
   279→
   280→		if checkpoint.CheckpointUUID != "" {
   281→			// Truncate transcript at checkpoint UUID
   282→			if err := restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript(start, *selectedPoint, sessionID, checkpoint.CheckpointUUID, agent); err != nil {
   283→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore truncated session transcript: %v\n", err)
   284→			} else {
   285→				fmt.Printf("Rewound to task checkpoint. %s\n", formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   286→			}
   287→			return nil
   288→		}
   289→	} else {
   290→		// For session checkpoint: restore full transcript
   291→		// Prefer SessionID from trailer (set by GetRewindPoints from Entire-Session trailer)
   292→		// over path-based extraction which is less reliable.
   293→		sessionID = selectedPoint.SessionID
   294→		if sessionID == "" {
   295→			sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(selectedPoint.MetadataDir)
   296→		}
   297→		transcriptFile = filepath.Join(selectedPoint.MetadataDir, paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy)
   298→	}
   299→
   300→	// Try to restore transcript using the appropriate method:
   301→	// 1. Checkpoint storage (committed checkpoints with valid checkpoint ID)
   302→	// 2. Shadow branch (uncommitted checkpoints with commit hash)
   303→	// 3. Local file (active sessions)
   304→	var restored bool
   305→	if !selectedPoint.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   306→		// Try checkpoint storage first for committed checkpoints
   307→		if returnedSessionID, err := restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(selectedPoint.CheckpointID, sessionID, agent); err == nil {
   308→			sessionID = returnedSessionID
   309→			restored = true
   310→		}
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	if !restored && selectedPoint.MetadataDir != "" && len(selectedPoint.ID) == 40 {
   314→		// Try shadow branch for uncommitted checkpoints (ID is a 40-char commit hash)
   315→		if returnedSessionID, err := restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow(selectedPoint.ID, selectedPoint.MetadataDir, sessionID, agent); err == nil {
   316→			sessionID = returnedSessionID
   317→			restored = true
   318→		}
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	if !restored {

   325→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Source: %s\n", transcriptFile)
   326→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session ID: %s\n", sessionID)
   327→		}
   328→	}
   329→
   330→	fmt.Printf("Rewound to %s. %s\n", shortID, formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   331→	return nil
   332→}

   334→func runRewindList() error {
   335→	start := GetStrategy()
   336→
   337→	points, err := start.GetRewindPoints(20)
   338→	if err != nil {
   339→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find rewind points: %w", err)
   340→	}
   341→
   342→	// Output as JSON for programmatic use
   343→	type jsonPoint struct {
   344→		ID               string `json:"id"`
   345→		Message          string `json:"message"`
   346→		MetadataDir      string `json:"metadata_dir"`
   347→		Date             string `json:"date"`
   348→		IsTaskCheckpoint bool   `json:"is_task_checkpoint"`
   349→		ToolUseID        string `json:"tool_use_id,omitempty"`
   350→		IsLogsOnly       bool   `json:"is_logs_only"`
   351→		CondensationID   string `json:"condensation_id,omitempty"`
   352→		SessionID        string `json:"session_id,omitempty"`
   353→		SessionPrompt    string `json:"session_prompt,omitempty"`
   354→	}
   355→
   356→	output := make([]jsonPoint, len(points))
   357→	for i, p := range points {
   358→		output[i] = jsonPoint{
   359→			ID:               p.ID,
   360→			Message:          p.Message,
   361→			MetadataDir:      p.MetadataDir,
   362→			Date:             p.Date.Format(time.RFC3339),
   363→			IsTaskCheckpoint: p.IsTaskCheckpoint,
   364→			ToolUseID:        p.ToolUseID,
   365→			IsLogsOnly:       p.IsLogsOnly,
   366→			CondensationID:   p.CheckpointID.String(),
   367→			SessionID:        p.SessionID,
   368→			SessionPrompt:    p.SessionPrompt,
   369→		}
   370→	}
   371→
   372→	// Print as JSON
   373→	data, err := jsonutil.MarshalIndentWithNewline(output, "", "  ")
   374→	if err != nil {
   375→		return err //nolint:wrapcheck // already present in codebase
   376→	}
   377→	fmt.Println(string(data))
   378→	return nil
   379→}

   381→func runRewindToWithOptions(commitID string, logsOnly bool, reset bool) error {
   382→	return runRewindToInternal(commitID, logsOnly, reset)
   383→}
   384→
   385→func runRewindToInternal(commitID string, logsOnly bool, reset bool) error {
   386→	start := GetStrategy()
   387→
   388→	// Check for uncommitted changes (skip for reset which handles this itself)
   389→	if !reset {
   390→		canRewind, changeMsg, err := start.CanRewind()
   391→		if err != nil {
   392→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to check for uncommitted changes: %w", err)
   393→		}
   394→		if !canRewind {
   395→			return fmt.Errorf("%s", changeMsg)
   396→		}
   397→	}
   398→
   399→	// Get rewind points
   400→	points, err := start.GetRewindPoints(20)
   401→	if err != nil {
   402→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to find rewind points: %w", err)
   403→	}
   404→
   405→	// Find the matching point (support both full and short commit IDs)
   406→	var selectedPoint *strategy.RewindPoint
   407→	for _, p := range points {
   408→		if p.ID == commitID || (len(commitID) >= 7 && len(p.ID) >= 7 && strings.HasPrefix(p.ID, commitID)) {
   409→			pointCopy := p
   410→			selectedPoint = &pointCopy
   411→			break
   412→		}
   413→	}
   414→
   415→	if selectedPoint == nil {
   416→		return fmt.Errorf("rewind point not found: %s", commitID)
   417→	}
   418→
   419→	// Handle reset mode (for logs-only points)
   420→	if reset {
   421→		return handleLogsOnlyResetNonInteractive(start, *selectedPoint)
   422→	}
   423→
   424→	// Handle logs-only restoration:
   425→	// 1. For logs-only points, always use logs-only restoration
   426→	// 2. If --logs-only flag is set, use logs-only restoration even for checkpoint points
   427→	if selectedPoint.IsLogsOnly || logsOnly {
   428→		return handleLogsOnlyRewindNonInteractive(start, *selectedPoint)
   429→	}
   430→
   431→	// Preview rewind to show warnings about files that will be deleted
   432→	preview, previewErr := start.PreviewRewind(*selectedPoint)
   433→	if previewErr == nil && preview != nil && len(preview.FilesToDelete) > 0 {
   434→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nWarning: The following untracked files will be DELETED:\n")
   435→		for _, f := range preview.FilesToDelete {
   436→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", f)
   437→		}
   438→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\n")
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   442→	agent, err := getAgent(selectedPoint.Agent)
   443→	if err != nil {
   444→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   445→	}
   446→
   447→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   448→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   449→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   450→
   451→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind started",
   452→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   453→		slog.String("session_id", selectedPoint.SessionID),
   454→		slog.Bool("is_task_checkpoint", selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint),
   455→	)
   456→
   457→	// Perform the rewind
   458→	if err := start.Rewind(*selectedPoint); err != nil {
   459→		logging.Error(ctx, "rewind failed",
   460→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   461→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   462→		)
   463→		return err //nolint:wrapcheck // already present in codebase
   464→	}
   465→
   466→	logging.Debug(ctx, "rewind completed",
   467→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", selectedPoint.ID),
   468→	)
   469→
   470→	// Handle transcript restoration
   471→	var sessionID string
   472→	var transcriptFile string
   473→
   474→	if selectedPoint.IsTaskCheckpoint {
   475→		checkpoint, err := start.GetTaskCheckpoint(*selectedPoint)
   476→		if err != nil {
   477→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to read task checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   478→			return nil
   479→		}
   480→
   481→		sessionID = checkpoint.SessionID
   482→
   483→		if checkpoint.CheckpointUUID != "" {
   484→			// Use strategy-based transcript restoration for task checkpoints
   485→			if err := restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript(start, *selectedPoint, sessionID, checkpoint.CheckpointUUID, agent); err != nil {
   486→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore truncated session transcript: %v\n", err)
   487→			} else {
   488→				fmt.Printf("Rewound to task checkpoint. %s\n", formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   489→			}
   490→			return nil
   491→		}
   492→	} else {
   493→		// Prefer SessionID from trailer over path-based extraction
   494→		sessionID = selectedPoint.SessionID
   495→		if sessionID == "" {
   496→			sessionID = extractSessionIDFromMetadata(selectedPoint.MetadataDir)
   497→		}
   498→		transcriptFile = filepath.Join(selectedPoint.MetadataDir, paths.TranscriptFileNameLegacy)
   499→	}
   500→
   501→	// Try to restore transcript using the appropriate method:
   502→	// 1. Checkpoint storage (committed checkpoints with valid checkpoint ID)
   503→	// 2. Shadow branch (uncommitted checkpoints with commit hash)
   504→	// 3. Local file (active sessions)
   505→	var restored bool
   506→	if !selectedPoint.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   507→		// Try checkpoint storage first for committed checkpoints
   508→		if returnedSessionID, err := restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(selectedPoint.CheckpointID, sessionID, agent); err == nil {
   509→			sessionID = returnedSessionID
   510→			restored = true
   511→		}
   512→	}
   513→
   514→	if !restored && selectedPoint.MetadataDir != "" && len(selectedPoint.ID) == 40 {
   515→		// Try shadow branch for uncommitted checkpoints (ID is a 40-char commit hash)
   516→		if returnedSessionID, err := restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow(selectedPoint.ID, selectedPoint.MetadataDir, sessionID, agent); err == nil {
   517→			sessionID = returnedSessionID
   518→			restored = true
   519→		}
   520→	}
   521→
   522→	if !restored {
   523→		// Fall back to local file
   524→		if err := restoreSessionTranscript(transcriptFile, sessionID, agent); err != nil {
   525→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to restore session transcript: %v\n", err)
   526→		}
   527→	}
   528→
   529→	fmt.Printf("Rewound to %s. %s\n", selectedPoint.ID[:7], formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent))
   530→	return nil
   531→}

   533→// handleLogsOnlyRewindNonInteractive handles logs-only rewind in non-interactive mode.
   534→// Defaults to restoring logs only (no checkout) for safety.
   535→func handleLogsOnlyRewindNonInteractive(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint) error {
   536→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   537→	agent, err := getAgent(point.Agent)
   538→	if err != nil {
   539→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   540→	}
   541→
   542→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   543→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   544→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   545→
   546→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only rewind started",
   547→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   548→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   549→	)
   550→
   551→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   552→	if !ok {
   553→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   554→	}
   555→
   556→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   557→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only rewind failed",
   558→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   559→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   560→		)
   561→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   562→	}
   563→
   564→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only rewind completed",
   565→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   566→	)
   567→
   568→	// Show resume commands for all sessions
   569→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   570→
   571→	fmt.Println("Note: Working directory unchanged. Use interactive mode for full checkout.")
   572→	return nil
   573→}

   575→// handleLogsOnlyResetNonInteractive handles reset in non-interactive mode.
   576→// This performs a git reset --hard to the target commit.
   577→func handleLogsOnlyResetNonInteractive(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint) error {
   578→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   579→	agent, err := getAgent(point.Agent)
   580→	if err != nil {
   581→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   582→	}
   583→
   584→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   585→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   586→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   587→
   588→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset started",
   589→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   590→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   591→	)
   592→
   593→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   594→	if !ok {
   595→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   596→	}
   597→
   598→	// Get current HEAD before reset (for recovery message)
   599→	currentHead, headErr := getCurrentHeadHash()
   600→	if headErr != nil {
   601→		currentHead = ""
   602→	}
   603→
   604→	// Restore logs first
   605→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   606→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during log restoration",
   607→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   608→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   609→		)
   610→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   611→	}
   612→
   613→	// Perform git reset --hard
   614→	if err := performGitResetHard(point.ID); err != nil {
   615→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during git reset",
   616→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   617→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   618→		)
   619→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to reset branch: %w", err)
   620→	}
   621→
   622→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset completed",
   623→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   624→	)
   625→
   626→	shortID := point.ID
   627→	if len(shortID) > 7 {
   628→		shortID = shortID[:7]
   629→	}
   630→
   631→	fmt.Printf("Reset branch to %s.\n", shortID)
   632→
   633→	// Show resume commands for all sessions
   634→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   635→
   636→	// Show recovery instructions
   637→	if currentHead != "" && currentHead != point.ID {
   638→		currentShort := currentHead
   639→		if len(currentShort) > 7 {
   640→			currentShort = currentShort[:7]
   641→		}
   642→		fmt.Printf("\nTo undo this reset: git reset --hard %s\n", currentShort)
   643→	}
   644→
   645→	return nil
   646→}

   648→func extractSessionIDFromMetadata(metadataDir string) string {
   649→	// The metadata directory name IS the Entire session ID.
   650→	// For new format: .entire/metadata/<agent-session-id> (e.g., UUID)
   651→	// For legacy format: .entire/metadata/<date-prefixed-id>
   652→	// Date-prefix stripping (for legacy IDs) is handled downstream by
   653→	// ExtractAgentSessionID/ModelSessionID, so we return the full name here.
   654→	return filepath.Base(metadataDir)
   655→}

   657→func restoreSessionTranscript(transcriptFile, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) error {
   658→	sessionFile, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, agent)
   659→	if err != nil {
   660→		return err
   661→	}
   662→
   663→	// Ensure parent directory exists
   664→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionFile), 0o750); err != nil {
   665→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   666→	}
   667→
   668→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copying transcript:\n  From: %s\n  To: %s\n", transcriptFile, sessionFile)
   669→	if err := copyFile(transcriptFile, sessionFile); err != nil {
   670→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   671→	}
   672→
   673→	return nil
   674→}
   675→
   676→// restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy restores a session transcript from checkpoint storage.
   677→// This is used for strategies that store transcripts in git branches rather than local files.
   678→// Returns the session ID that was actually used (may differ from input if checkpoint provides one).
   679→func restoreSessionTranscriptFromStrategy(cpID id.CheckpointID, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   680→	// Get transcript content from checkpoint storage
   681→	content, returnedSessionID, err := checkpoint.LookupSessionLog(cpID)
   682→	if err != nil {
   683→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get session log: %w", err)
   684→	}
   685→
   686→	// Use session ID returned from checkpoint if available
   687→	// Otherwise fall back to the passed-in sessionID
   688→	if returnedSessionID != "" {
   689→		sessionID = returnedSessionID
   690→	}
   691→
   692→	return writeTranscriptToAgentSession(content, sessionID, agent)
   693→}
   694→
   695→// restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow restores a session transcript from a shadow branch commit.
   696→// This is used for uncommitted checkpoints where the transcript is stored in the shadow branch tree.
   697→func restoreSessionTranscriptFromShadow(commitHash, metadataDir, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   698→	// Open repository
   699→	repo, err := git.PlainOpenWithOptions(".", &git.PlainOpenOptions{DetectDotGit: true})
   700→	if err != nil {
   701→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to open repository: %w", err)
   702→	}
   703→
   704→	// Parse commit hash
   705→	hash := plumbing.NewHash(commitHash)
   706→	if hash.IsZero() {
   707→		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid commit hash: %s", commitHash)
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	// Get transcript from shadow branch commit tree
   711→	store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   712→	content, err := store.GetTranscriptFromCommit(hash, metadataDir, agent.Type())
   713→	if err != nil {
   714→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get transcript from shadow branch: %w", err)
   715→	}
   716→
   717→	return writeTranscriptToAgentSession(content, sessionID, agent)
   718→}
   719→
   720→// writeTranscriptToAgentSession writes transcript content to the agent's session storage.
   721→func writeTranscriptToAgentSession(content []byte, sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   722→	sessionFile, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, agent)
   723→	if err != nil {
   724→		return "", err
   725→	}
   726→
   727→	// Ensure parent directory exists
   728→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionFile), 0o750); err != nil {
   729→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   730→	}
   731→
   732→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   733→	if err := os.WriteFile(sessionFile, content, 0o600); err != nil {
   734→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", err)
   735→	}
   736→
   737→	return sessionID, nil
   738→}
   739→
   740→// resolveTranscriptPath determines the correct file path for an agent's session transcript.
   741→// It first checks the session state for a transcript_path (set by the agent's hook data,
   742→// e.g. Gemini stores files at a hashed path that GetSessionDir can't reconstruct).
   743→// Falls back to GetSessionDir + ResolveSessionFile if no session state is available.
   744→func resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) (string, error) {
   745→	// Try session state first - it has the exact transcript path from hook data
   746→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   747→	if err == nil && state != nil && state.TranscriptPath != "" {
   748→		return state.TranscriptPath, nil
   749→	}
   750→
   751→	// Fall back to agent's directory + file resolution
   752→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   753→	if err != nil {
   754→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   755→	}
   756→
   757→	agentSessionDir, err := agent.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   758→	if err != nil {
   759→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent session directory: %w", err)
   760→	}
   761→
   762→	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   763→	return agent.ResolveSessionFile(agentSessionDir, agentSessionID), nil
   764→}
   765→
   766→// restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript restores a truncated transcript for a task checkpoint.
   767→// Uses GetTaskCheckpointTranscript to fetch the transcript from the strategy.
   768→//
   769→// NOTE: The transcript parsing/truncation/writing pipeline (parseTranscriptFromBytes,
   770→// TruncateTranscriptAtUUID, writeTranscript) assumes Claude's JSONL format.
   771→// This is acceptable because task checkpoints are currently only created by Claude Code's
   772→// PostToolUse hook. If other agents gain sub-agent support, this will need a
   773→// format-aware refactor (agent-specific parsing, truncation, and serialization).
   774→func restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript(strat strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, sessionID, checkpointUUID string, agent agentpkg.Agent) error {
   775→	// Get transcript content from strategy
   776→	content, err := strat.GetTaskCheckpointTranscript(point)
   777→	if err != nil {
   778→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get task checkpoint transcript: %w", err)
   779→	}
   780→
   781→	// Parse the transcript
   782→	transcript, err := parseTranscriptFromBytes(content)
   783→	if err != nil {
   784→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   785→	}
   786→
   787→	// Truncate at checkpoint UUID
   788→	truncated := TruncateTranscriptAtUUID(transcript, checkpointUUID)
   789→
   790→	sessionFile, err := resolveTranscriptPath(sessionID, agent)
   791→	if err != nil {
   792→		return err
   793→	}
   794→
   795→	// Ensure parent directory exists
   796→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(sessionFile), 0o750); err != nil {
   797→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   798→	}
   799→
   800→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing truncated transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   801→
   802→	if err := writeTranscript(sessionFile, truncated); err != nil {
   803→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write truncated transcript: %w", err)
   804→	}
   805→
   806→	return nil
   807→}

   809→// createContextFileMinimal creates a context file without staged files info
   810→// (since the strategy will handle staging)
   811→func createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile string, transcript []transcriptLine) error {
   812→	prompt, _ := os.ReadFile(promptFile)   //nolint:errcheck,gosec // Best-effort loading of optional context files
   813→	summary, _ := os.ReadFile(summaryFile) //nolint:errcheck,gosec // Best-effort loading of optional context files
   814→	keyActions := extractKeyActions(transcript, 10)
   815→
   816→	var content strings.Builder
   817→	content.WriteString("# Session Context\n\n")
   818→	content.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Session ID:** %s\n\n", sessionID))
   819→	content.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Commit Message:** %s\n\n", commitMessage))
   820→	content.WriteString("## Prompt\n\n")
   821→	content.Write(prompt)
   822→	content.WriteString("\n\n## Summary\n\n")
   823→	content.Write(summary)
   824→	content.WriteString("\n\n## Key Actions\n\n")
   825→	for _, action := range keyActions {
   826→		content.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("- %s\n", action))
   827→	}
   828→
   829→	if err := os.WriteFile(contextFile, []byte(content.String()), 0o600); err != nil {
   830→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write context file: %w", err)
   831→	}
   832→	return nil
   833→}

   835→// handleLogsOnlyRewindInteractive handles rewind for logs-only points with a sub-choice menu.
   836→func handleLogsOnlyRewindInteractive(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, shortID string) error {
   837→	var action string
   838→
   839→	form := NewAccessibleForm(
   840→		huh.NewGroup(
   841→			huh.NewSelect[string]().
   842→				Title("Logs-only point: "+shortID).
   843→				Description("This commit has session logs but no checkpoint state. Choose an action:").
   844→				Options(
   845→					huh.NewOption("Restore logs only (keep current files)", "logs"),
   846→					huh.NewOption("Checkout commit (detached HEAD, for viewing)", "checkout"),
   847→					huh.NewOption("Reset branch to this commit (destructive!)", "reset"),
   848→					huh.NewOption("Cancel", "cancel"),
   849→				).
   850→				Value(&action),
   851→		),
   852→	)
   853→
   854→	if err := form.Run(); err != nil {
   855→		return fmt.Errorf("action selection cancelled: %w", err)
   856→	}
   857→
   858→	switch action {
   859→	case "logs":
   860→		return handleLogsOnlyRestore(start, point)
   861→	case "checkout":
   862→		return handleLogsOnlyCheckout(start, point, shortID)
   863→	case "reset":
   864→		return handleLogsOnlyReset(start, point, shortID)
   865→	case "cancel":
   866→		fmt.Println("Rewind cancelled.")
   867→		return nil
   868→	}
   869→
   870→	return nil
   871→}

   915→// handleLogsOnlyCheckout restores logs and checks out the commit (detached HEAD).
   916→func handleLogsOnlyCheckout(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, shortID string) error {
   917→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   918→	agent, err := getAgent(point.Agent)
   919→	if err != nil {
   920→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   921→	}
   922→
   923→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   924→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   925→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   926→
   927→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only checkout started",
   928→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   929→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
   930→	)
   931→
   932→	// First, restore the logs
   933→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
   934→	if !ok {
   935→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
   936→	}
   937→
   938→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
   939→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only checkout failed during log restoration",
   940→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   941→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   942→		)
   943→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
   944→	}
   945→
   946→	// Show warning about detached HEAD
   947→	var confirm bool
   948→	confirmForm := NewAccessibleForm(
   949→		huh.NewGroup(
   950→			huh.NewConfirm().
   951→				Title("Create detached HEAD?").
   952→				Description("This will checkout the commit directly. You'll be in 'detached HEAD' state.\nAny uncommitted changes will be lost!").
   953→				Value(&confirm),
   954→		),
   955→	)
   956→
   957→	if err := confirmForm.Run(); err != nil {
   958→		return fmt.Errorf("confirmation cancelled: %w", err)
   959→	}
   960→
   961→	if !confirm {
   962→		fmt.Println("Checkout cancelled. Session logs were still restored.")
   963→		printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   964→		return nil
   965→	}
   966→
   967→	// Perform git checkout
   968→	if err := CheckoutBranch(point.ID); err != nil {
   969→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only checkout failed during git checkout",
   970→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   971→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
   972→		)
   973→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to checkout commit: %w", err)
   974→	}
   975→
   976→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only checkout completed",
   977→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   978→	)
   979→
   980→	fmt.Printf("Checked out %s (detached HEAD).\n", shortID)
   981→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
   982→	return nil
   983→}
   984→
   985→// handleLogsOnlyReset restores logs and resets the branch to the commit (destructive).
   986→func handleLogsOnlyReset(start strategy.Strategy, point strategy.RewindPoint, shortID string) error {
   987→	// Resolve agent once for use throughout
   988→	agent, agentErr := getAgent(point.Agent)
   989→	if agentErr != nil {
   990→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", agentErr)
   991→	}
   992→
   993→	// Initialize logging context with agent from checkpoint
   994→	ctx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "rewind")
   995→	ctx = logging.WithAgent(ctx, agent.Name())
   996→
   997→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset (interactive) started",
   998→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
   999→		slog.String("session_id", point.SessionID),
  1000→	)
  1001→
  1002→	// First, restore the logs
  1003→	restorer, ok := start.(strategy.LogsOnlyRestorer)
  1004→	if !ok {
  1005→		return errors.New("strategy does not support logs-only restoration")
  1006→	}
  1007→
  1008→	if err := restorer.RestoreLogsOnly(point, true); err != nil { // force=true for explicit rewind
  1009→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during log restoration",
  1010→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1011→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1012→		)
  1013→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to restore logs: %w", err)
  1014→	}
  1015→
  1016→	// Get current HEAD before reset (for recovery message)
  1017→	currentHead, err := getCurrentHeadHash()
  1018→	if err != nil {
  1019→		// Non-fatal - just won't show recovery message
  1020→		currentHead = ""
  1021→	}
  1022→
  1023→	// Get detailed uncommitted changes warning from strategy
  1024→	var uncommittedWarning string
  1025→	if _, warn, err := start.CanRewind(); err == nil {
  1026→		uncommittedWarning = warn
  1027→	}
  1028→
  1029→	// Check for safety issues
  1030→	warnings, err := checkResetSafety(point.ID, uncommittedWarning)
  1031→	if err != nil {
  1032→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to check reset safety: %w", err)
  1033→	}
  1034→
  1035→	// Build confirmation message based on warnings
  1036→	var confirmTitle, confirmDesc string
  1037→	if len(warnings) > 0 {
  1038→		confirmTitle = "⚠️  Reset branch with warnings?"
  1039→		confirmDesc = "WARNING - the following issues were detected:\n" +
  1040→			strings.Join(warnings, "\n") +
  1041→			"\n\nThis will move your branch to " + shortID + " and DISCARD commits after it!"
  1042→	} else {
  1043→		confirmTitle = "Reset branch to " + shortID + "?"
  1044→		confirmDesc = "This will move your branch pointer to this commit.\nCommits after this point will be orphaned (but recoverable via reflog)."
  1045→	}
  1046→
  1047→	var confirm bool
  1048→	confirmForm := NewAccessibleForm(
  1049→		huh.NewGroup(
  1050→			huh.NewConfirm().
  1051→				Title(confirmTitle).
  1052→				Description(confirmDesc).
  1053→				Value(&confirm),
  1054→		),
  1055→	)
  1056→
  1057→	if err := confirmForm.Run(); err != nil {
  1058→		return fmt.Errorf("confirmation cancelled: %w", err)
  1059→	}
  1060→
  1061→	if !confirm {
  1062→		fmt.Println("Reset cancelled. Session logs were still restored.")
  1063→		printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
  1064→		return nil
  1065→	}
  1066→
  1067→	// Perform git reset --hard
  1068→	if err := performGitResetHard(point.ID); err != nil {
  1069→		logging.Error(ctx, "logs-only reset failed during git reset",
  1070→			slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1071→			slog.String("error", err.Error()),
  1072→		)
  1073→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to reset branch: %w", err)
  1074→	}
  1075→
  1076→	logging.Debug(ctx, "logs-only reset (interactive) completed",
  1077→		slog.String("checkpoint_id", point.ID),
  1078→	)
  1079→
  1080→	fmt.Printf("Reset branch to %s.\n", shortID)
  1081→	printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point, agent)
  1082→
  1083→	// Show recovery instructions
  1084→	if currentHead != "" && currentHead != point.ID {
  1085→		currentShort := currentHead
  1086→		if len(currentShort) > 7 {
  1087→			currentShort = currentShort[:7]
  1088→		}
  1089→		fmt.Printf("\nTo undo this reset: git reset --hard %s\n", currentShort)
  1090→	}
  1091→
  1092→	return nil
  1093→}

  1095→// getCurrentHeadHash returns the current HEAD commit hash.
  1096→func getCurrentHeadHash() (string, error) {
  1097→	repo, err := openRepository()
  1098→	if err != nil {
  1099→		return "", err
  1100→	}
  1101→
  1102→	head, err := repo.Head()
  1103→	if err != nil {
  1104→		return "", fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)

  1110→// checkResetSafety checks for potential issues before a git reset --hard.
  1111→// Returns a list of warning messages (empty if safe to proceed without warnings).
  1112→// If uncommittedChangesWarning is provided, it will be used instead of a generic warning.
  1113→func checkResetSafety(targetCommitHash string, uncommittedChangesWarning string) ([]string, error) {
  1114→	var warnings []string
  1115→
  1116→	repo, err := openRepository()
  1117→	if err != nil {
  1118→		return nil, err
  1119→	}
  1120→
  1121→	// Check for uncommitted changes
  1122→	if uncommittedChangesWarning != "" {
  1123→		// Use the detailed warning from strategy's CanRewind()
  1124→		warnings = append(warnings, uncommittedChangesWarning)
  1125→	} else {
  1126→		// Fall back to generic check
  1127→		worktree, err := repo.Worktree()
  1128→		if err != nil {
  1129→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get worktree: %w", err)
  1130→		}
  1131→
  1132→		status, err := worktree.Status()
  1133→		if err != nil {
  1134→			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get status: %w", err)
  1135→		}
  1136→
  1137→		if !status.IsClean() {
  1138→			warnings = append(warnings, "• You have uncommitted changes that will be LOST")
  1139→		}
  1140→	}
  1141→
  1142→	// Check if current HEAD is ahead of target (we'd be discarding commits)
  1143→	head, err := repo.Head()
  1144→	if err != nil {
  1145→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
  1146→	}
  1147→
  1148→	targetHash := plumbing.NewHash(targetCommitHash)
  1149→
  1150→	// Count commits between target and HEAD
  1151→	commitsAhead, err := countCommitsBetween(repo, targetHash, head.Hash())
  1152→	if err != nil {
  1153→		// Non-fatal - just can't show commit count
  1154→		commitsAhead = -1
  1155→	}
  1156→
  1157→	if commitsAhead > 0 {
  1158→		warnings = append(warnings, fmt.Sprintf("• %d commit(s) after this point will be orphaned", commitsAhead))
  1159→	}
  1160→
  1161→	return warnings, nil
  1162→}
  1163→
  1164→// countCommitsBetween counts commits between ancestor and descendant.
  1165→// Returns 0 if ancestor == descendant, -1 on error.
  1166→func countCommitsBetween(repo *git.Repository, ancestor, descendant plumbing.Hash) (int, error) {
  1167→	if ancestor == descendant {
  1168→		return 0, nil
  1169→	}
  1170→
  1171→	// Walk from descendant back to ancestor
  1172→	count := 0
  1173→	current := descendant
  1174→
  1175→	for count < 1000 { // Safety limit
  1176→		if current == ancestor {
  1177→			return count, nil
  1178→		}
  1179→
  1180→		commit, err := repo.CommitObject(current)
  1181→		if err != nil {
  1182→			return -1, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
  1183→		}
  1184→
  1185→		if commit.NumParents() == 0 {
  1186→			// Reached root without finding ancestor - ancestor not in history
  1187→			return -1, nil
  1188→		}
  1189→
  1190→		count++
  1191→		current = commit.ParentHashes[0] // Follow first parent
  1192→	}
  1193→
  1194→	return -1, nil
  1195→}
  1196→
  1197→// performGitResetHard performs a git reset --hard to the specified commit.
  1198→// Uses the git CLI instead of go-git because go-git's HardReset incorrectly
  1199→// deletes untracked directories (like .entire/) even when they're in .gitignore.
  1200→func performGitResetHard(commitHash string) error {
  1201→	ctx := context.Background()
  1202→	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "reset", "--hard", commitHash)
  1203→	if output, err := cmd.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
  1204→		return fmt.Errorf("reset failed: %s: %w", strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), err)
  1205→	}
  1206→	return nil
  1207→}

  1209→// sanitizeForTerminal removes or replaces characters that cause rendering issues
  1210→// in terminal UI components. This includes emojis with skin-tone modifiers and
  1211→// other multi-codepoint characters that confuse width calculations.
  1212→func sanitizeForTerminal(s string) string {
  1213→	var result strings.Builder
  1214→	result.Grow(len(s))
  1215→
  1216→	for _, r := range s {
  1217→		// Skip emoji skin tone modifiers (U+1F3FB to U+1F3FF)
  1218→		if r >= 0x1F3FB && r <= 0x1F3FF {
  1219→			continue
  1220→		}
  1221→		// Skip zero-width joiners used in emoji sequences
  1222→		if r == 0x200D {
  1223→			continue
  1224→		}
  1225→		// Skip variation selectors (U+FE00 to U+FE0F)
  1226→		if r >= 0xFE00 && r <= 0xFE0F {
  1227→			continue
  1228→		}
  1229→		// Keep printable characters and common whitespace
  1230→		if unicode.IsPrint(r) || r == '\t' || r == '\n' {
  1231→			result.WriteRune(r)
  1232→		}
  1233→	}
  1234→
  1235→	return result.String()
  1236→}

  1244→// printMultiSessionResumeCommands prints resume commands for all sessions in a rewind point.
  1245→// For single-session checkpoints, prints a single resume command.
  1246→// For multi-session checkpoints, prints all sessions with prompts as comments.
  1247→func printMultiSessionResumeCommands(point strategy.RewindPoint, agent agentpkg.Agent) {
  1248→	// Check if this is a multi-session checkpoint
  1249→	if point.SessionCount > 1 && len(point.SessionIDs) > 1 {
  1250→		fmt.Printf("\nRestored %d sessions. Resume with:\n", point.SessionCount)
  1251→
  1252→		// Print each session with prompt as comment
  1253→		for i, sessionID := range point.SessionIDs {
  1254→			cmd := formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent)
  1255→
  1256→			// Get prompt for this session (if available)
  1257→			var prompt string
  1258→			if i < len(point.SessionPrompts) {
  1259→				prompt = point.SessionPrompts[i]
  1260→			}
  1261→
  1262→			// Add "(most recent)" label to the last session
  1263→			if i == len(point.SessionIDs)-1 {
  1264→				if prompt != "" {
  1265→					fmt.Printf("  %s  # %s (most recent)\n", cmd, prompt)
  1266→				} else {
  1267→					fmt.Printf("  %s  # (most recent)\n", cmd)
  1268→				}
  1269→			} else {
  1270→				if prompt != "" {
  1271→					fmt.Printf("  %s  # %s\n", cmd, prompt)
  1272→				} else {
  1273→					fmt.Printf("  %s\n", cmd)
  1274→				}
  1275→			}
  1276→		}
  1277→	} else {
  1278→		// Single session - use traditional format with prompt if available
  1279→		sessionID := point.SessionID
  1280→		if sessionID == "" && len(point.SessionIDs) > 0 {
  1281→			sessionID = point.SessionIDs[len(point.SessionIDs)-1]
  1282→		}
  1283→		if sessionID != "" {
  1284→			cmd := formatResumeCommand(sessionID, agent)
  1285→			if point.SessionPrompt != "" {
  1286→				fmt.Printf("%s  # %s\n", cmd, point.SessionPrompt)
  1287→			} else {
  1288→				fmt.Printf("%s\n", cmd)
  1289→			}
  1290→		}
  1291→	}
  1292→}

    26→// GetRewindPoints returns available rewind points.
    27→// Uses checkpoint.GitStore.ListTemporaryCheckpoints for reading from shadow branches.
    28→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetRewindPoints(limit int) ([]RewindPoint, error) {
    29→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
    30→	if err != nil {
    31→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
    32→	}
    33→
    34→	// Get checkpoint store
    35→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
    36→	if err != nil {
    37→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
    38→	}
    39→
    40→	// Get current HEAD to find matching shadow branch
    41→	head, err := repo.Head()
    42→	if err != nil {
    43→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	// Find sessions for current HEAD
    47→	sessions, err := s.findSessionsForCommit(head.Hash().String())
    48→	if err != nil {
    49→		// Log error but continue to check for logs-only points
    50→		sessions = nil
    51→	}
    52→
    53→	var allPoints []RewindPoint
    54→
    55→	// Collect checkpoint points from active sessions using checkpoint.GitStore
    56→	// Cache session prompts by session ID to avoid re-reading the same prompt file
    57→	sessionPrompts := make(map[string]string)
    58→
    59→	for _, state := range sessions {
    60→		checkpoints, err := store.ListTemporaryCheckpoints(context.Background(), state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID, state.SessionID, limit)
    61→		if err != nil {
    62→			continue // Error reading checkpoints, skip this session
    63→		}
    64→
    65→		for _, cp := range checkpoints {
    66→			// Get session prompt (cached by session ID)
    67→			sessionPrompt, ok := sessionPrompts[cp.SessionID]
    68→			if !ok {
    69→				sessionPrompt = readSessionPrompt(repo, cp.CommitHash, cp.MetadataDir)
    70→				sessionPrompts[cp.SessionID] = sessionPrompt
    71→			}
    72→
    73→			allPoints = append(allPoints, RewindPoint{
    74→				ID:               cp.CommitHash.String(),
    75→				Message:          cp.Message,
    76→				MetadataDir:      cp.MetadataDir,
    77→				Date:             cp.Timestamp,
    78→				IsTaskCheckpoint: cp.IsTaskCheckpoint,
    79→				ToolUseID:        cp.ToolUseID,
    80→				SessionID:        cp.SessionID,
    81→				SessionPrompt:    sessionPrompt,
    82→				Agent:            state.AgentType,
    83→			})
    84→		}
    85→	}
    86→
    87→	// Sort by date, most recent first
    88→	sort.Slice(allPoints, func(i, j int) bool {
    89→		return allPoints[i].Date.After(allPoints[j].Date)
    90→	})
    91→
    92→	if len(allPoints) > limit {
    93→		allPoints = allPoints[:limit]
    94→	}
    95→
    96→	// Also include logs-only points from commit history
    97→	logsOnlyPoints, err := s.GetLogsOnlyRewindPoints(limit)
    98→	if err == nil && len(logsOnlyPoints) > 0 {
    99→		// Build set of existing point IDs for deduplication
   100→		existingIDs := make(map[string]bool)
   101→		for _, p := range allPoints {
   102→			existingIDs[p.ID] = true
   103→		}
   104→
   105→		// Add logs-only points that aren't already in the list
   106→		for _, p := range logsOnlyPoints {
   107→			if !existingIDs[p.ID] {
   108→				allPoints = append(allPoints, p)
   109→			}
   110→		}
   111→
   112→		// Re-sort by date
   113→		sort.Slice(allPoints, func(i, j int) bool {
   114→			return allPoints[i].Date.After(allPoints[j].Date)
   115→		})
   116→
   117→		// Re-trim to limit
   118→		if len(allPoints) > limit {
   119→			allPoints = allPoints[:limit]
   120→		}
   121→	}
   122→
   123→	return allPoints, nil
   124→}
   125→
   126→// GetLogsOnlyRewindPoints finds commits in the current branch's history that have
   127→// condensed session logs on the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch. These are commits that
   128→// were created with session data but the shadow branch has been condensed.
   129→//
   130→// The function works by:
   131→// 1. Getting all checkpoints from the entire/checkpoints/v1 branch
   132→// 2. Building a map of checkpoint ID -> checkpoint info
   133→// 3. Scanning the current branch history for commits with Entire-Checkpoint trailers
   134→// 4. Matching by checkpoint ID (stable across amend/rebase)
   135→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) GetLogsOnlyRewindPoints(limit int) ([]RewindPoint, error) {
   136→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   137→	if err != nil {
   138→		return nil, err
   139→	}
   140→
   141→	// Get all checkpoints from entire/checkpoints/v1 branch
   142→	checkpoints, err := s.listCheckpoints()
   143→	if err != nil {
   144→		// No checkpoints yet is fine
   145→		return nil, nil //nolint:nilerr // Expected when no checkpoints exist
   146→	}
   147→
   148→	if len(checkpoints) == 0 {
   149→		return nil, nil
   150→	}
   151→
   152→	// Build map of checkpoint ID -> checkpoint info
   153→	// Checkpoint ID is the stable link from Entire-Checkpoint trailer
   154→	checkpointInfoMap := make(map[id.CheckpointID]CheckpointInfo)
   155→	for _, cp := range checkpoints {
   156→		if !cp.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   157→			checkpointInfoMap[cp.CheckpointID] = cp
   158→		}
   159→	}
   160→
   161→	// Get metadata branch tree for reading session prompts (best-effort, ignore errors)
   162→	metadataTree, _ := GetMetadataBranchTree(repo) //nolint:errcheck // Best-effort for session prompts
   163→
   164→	head, err := repo.Head()
   165→	if err != nil {
   166→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   167→	}
   168→
   169→	// Use LogOptions with Order=LogOrderCommitterTime to traverse all parents of merge commits.
   170→	iter, err := repo.Log(&git.LogOptions{
   171→		From:  head.Hash(),
   172→		Order: git.LogOrderCommitterTime,
   173→	})
   174→	if err != nil {
   175→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit log: %w", err)
   176→	}
   177→
   178→	var points []RewindPoint
   179→	count := 0
   180→
   181→	err = iter.ForEach(func(c *object.Commit) error {
   182→		if count >= logsOnlyScanLimit {
   183→			return errStop
   184→		}
   185→		count++
   186→
   187→		// Extract checkpoint ID from Entire-Checkpoint trailer (ParseCheckpoint validates format)
   188→		cpID, found := trailers.ParseCheckpoint(c.Message)
   189→		if !found {
   190→			return nil
   191→		}
   192→		// Check if this checkpoint ID has metadata on entire/checkpoints/v1
   193→		cpInfo, found := checkpointInfoMap[cpID]
   194→		if !found {
   195→			return nil
   196→		}
   197→
   198→		// Create logs-only rewind point
   199→		message := strings.Split(c.Message, "\n")[0]
   200→
   201→		// Read session prompts from metadata tree
   202→		var sessionPrompt string
   203→		var sessionPrompts []string
   204→		if metadataTree != nil {
   205→			checkpointPath := paths.CheckpointPath(cpInfo.CheckpointID) //nolint:staticcheck // already present in codebase
   206→			// For multi-session checkpoints, read all prompts
   207→			if cpInfo.SessionCount > 1 && len(cpInfo.SessionIDs) > 1 {
   208→				sessionPrompts = ReadAllSessionPromptsFromTree(metadataTree, checkpointPath, cpInfo.SessionCount, cpInfo.SessionIDs)
   209→				// Use the last (most recent) prompt as the main session prompt
   210→				if len(sessionPrompts) > 0 {
   211→					sessionPrompt = sessionPrompts[len(sessionPrompts)-1]
   212→				}
   213→			} else {
   214→				sessionPrompt = ReadSessionPromptFromTree(metadataTree, checkpointPath)
   215→				if sessionPrompt != "" {
   216→					sessionPrompts = []string{sessionPrompt}
   217→				}
   218→			}
   219→		}
   220→
   221→		points = append(points, RewindPoint{
   222→			ID:             c.Hash.String(),
   223→			Message:        message,
   224→			Date:           c.Author.When,
   225→			IsLogsOnly:     true,
   226→			CheckpointID:   cpInfo.CheckpointID,
   227→			Agent:          cpInfo.Agent,
   228→			SessionID:      cpInfo.SessionID,
   229→			SessionPrompt:  sessionPrompt,
   230→			SessionCount:   cpInfo.SessionCount,
   231→			SessionIDs:     cpInfo.SessionIDs,
   232→			SessionPrompts: sessionPrompts,
   233→		})
   234→
   235→		return nil
   236→	})
   237→
   238→	if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, errStop) {
   239→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("error iterating commits: %w", err)
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	if len(points) > limit {
   243→		points = points[:limit]
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	return points, nil
   247→}

   249→// Rewind restores the working directory to a checkpoint.
   250→//
   251→
   252→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) Rewind(point RewindPoint) error {
   253→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   254→	if err != nil {
   255→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	// Get the checkpoint commit
   259→	commitHash := plumbing.NewHash(point.ID)
   260→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   261→	if err != nil {
   262→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   266→	if err != nil {
   267→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get tree: %w", err)
   268→	}
   269→
   270→	// Reset the shadow branch to the rewound checkpoint
   271→	// This ensures the next checkpoint will only include prompts from this point forward
   272→	if err := s.resetShadowBranchToCheckpoint(repo, commit); err != nil {
   273→		// Log warning but don't fail - file restoration is the primary operation
   274→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Warning: failed to reset shadow branch: %v\n", err)
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	// Load session state to get untracked files that existed at session start
   278→	sessionID, hasSessionTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   279→	var preservedUntrackedFiles map[string]bool
   280→	if hasSessionTrailer {
   281→		state, stateErr := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   282→		if stateErr == nil && state != nil && len(state.UntrackedFilesAtStart) > 0 {
   283→			preservedUntrackedFiles = make(map[string]bool)
   284→			for _, f := range state.UntrackedFilesAtStart {
   285→				preservedUntrackedFiles[f] = true
   286→			}
   287→		}
   288→	}
   289→
   290→	// Build set of files in the checkpoint tree (excluding metadata)
   291→	checkpointFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   292→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   293→		if !strings.HasPrefix(f.Name, entireDir) {
   294→			checkpointFiles[f.Name] = true
   295→		}
   296→		return nil
   297→	})
   298→	if err != nil {
   299→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to list checkpoint files: %w", err)
   300→	}
   301→
   302→	// Get HEAD tree to identify tracked files
   303→	head, err := repo.Head()
   304→	if err != nil {
   305→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   306→	}
   307→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   308→	if err != nil {
   309→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   310→	}
   311→	headTree, err := headCommit.Tree()
   312→	if err != nil {
   313→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD tree: %w", err)
   314→	}
   315→
   316→	// Build set of files tracked in HEAD
   317→	trackedFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   318→	//nolint:errcheck // Error is not critical for rewind
   319→	_ = headTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   320→		trackedFiles[f.Name] = true
   321→		return nil
   322→	})
   323→
   324→	// Get repository root to walk from there
   325→	repoRoot, err := GetWorktreePath()
   326→	if err != nil {
   327→		repoRoot = "." // Fallback to current directory
   328→	}
   329→
   330→	// Find and delete untracked files that aren't in the checkpoint
   331→	// These are likely files created by the agent in later checkpoints
   332→	err = filepath.Walk(repoRoot, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
   333→		if walkErr != nil {
   334→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Skip filesystem errors during walk
   335→		}
   336→
   337→		// Get path relative to repo root
   338→		relPath, relErr := filepath.Rel(repoRoot, path)
   339→		if relErr != nil {
   340→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Skip paths we can't make relative
   341→		}
   342→
   343→		// Skip directories and protected paths
   344→		if info.IsDir() {
   345→			if isProtectedPath(relPath) {
   346→				return filepath.SkipDir
   347→			}
   348→			return nil
   349→		}
   350→
   351→		// Skip files in protected directories
   352→		if isProtectedPath(relPath) {
   353→			return nil
   354→		}
   355→
   356→		// If file is in checkpoint, it will be restored
   357→		if checkpointFiles[relPath] {
   358→			return nil
   359→		}
   360→
   361→		// If file is tracked in HEAD, don't delete (user's committed work)
   362→		if trackedFiles[relPath] {
   363→			return nil
   364→		}
   365→
   366→		// If file existed at session start, preserve it (untracked user files)
   367→		if preservedUntrackedFiles[relPath] {
   368→			return nil
   369→		}
   370→
   371→		// File is untracked and not in checkpoint - delete it (use absolute path)
   372→		if removeErr := os.Remove(path); removeErr == nil {
   373→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Deleted: %s\n", relPath)
   374→		}
   375→
   376→		return nil
   377→	})
   378→	if err != nil {
   379→		// Non-fatal - continue with restoration
   380→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: error walking directory: %v\n", err)
   381→	}
   382→
   383→	// Restore files from checkpoint
   384→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   385→		// Skip metadata directories - these are for checkpoint storage, not working dir
   386→		if strings.HasPrefix(f.Name, entireDir) {
   387→			return nil
   388→		}
   389→
   390→		contents, err := f.Contents()
   391→		if err != nil {
   392→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to read file %s: %w", f.Name, err)
   393→		}
   394→
   395→		// Ensure directory exists
   396→		dir := filepath.Dir(f.Name)
   397→		if dir != "." {
   398→			//nolint:gosec // G301: Need 0o755 for user directories during rewind
   399→			if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
   400→				return fmt.Errorf("failed to create directory %s: %w", dir, err)
   401→			}
   402→		}
   403→
   404→		// Write file with appropriate permissions
   405→		var perm os.FileMode = 0o644
   406→		if f.Mode == filemode.Executable {
   407→			perm = 0o755
   408→		}
   409→		if err := os.WriteFile(f.Name, []byte(contents), perm); err != nil {
   410→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write file %s: %w", f.Name, err)
   411→		}
   412→
   413→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Restored: %s\n", f.Name)
   414→		return nil
   415→	})
   416→	if err != nil {
   417→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to iterate tree files: %w", err)
   418→	}
   419→
   420→	fmt.Println()
   421→	if len(point.ID) >= 7 {
   422→		fmt.Printf("Restored files from shadow commit %s\n", point.ID[:7])
   423→	} else {
   424→		fmt.Printf("Restored files from shadow commit %s\n", point.ID)
   425→	}
   426→	fmt.Println()
   427→
   428→	return nil
   429→}
   430→
   431→// resetShadowBranchToCheckpoint resets the shadow branch HEAD to the given checkpoint.
   432→// This ensures that when the user commits after rewinding, the next checkpoint will only
   433→// include prompts from the rewound point, not prompts from later checkpoints.
   434→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) resetShadowBranchToCheckpoint(repo *git.Repository, commit *object.Commit) error {
   435→	// Extract session ID from the checkpoint commit's Entire-Session trailer
   436→	sessionID, found := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   437→	if !found {
   438→		return errors.New("checkpoint has no Entire-Session trailer")
   439→	}
   440→
   441→	// Load session state to get the shadow branch name
   442→	state, err := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   443→	if err != nil {
   444→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   445→	}
   446→	if state == nil {
   447→		return fmt.Errorf("session %s not found", sessionID)
   448→	}
   449→
   450→	// Reset the shadow branch to the checkpoint commit
   451→	shadowBranchName := getShadowBranchNameForCommit(state.BaseCommit, state.WorktreeID)
   452→	refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranchName)
   453→
   454→	// Update the reference to point to the checkpoint commit
   455→	ref := plumbing.NewHashReference(refName, commit.Hash)
   456→	if err := repo.Storer.SetReference(ref); err != nil {
   457→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to update shadow branch: %w", err)
   458→	}
   459→
   460→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Reset shadow branch %s to checkpoint %s\n", shadowBranchName, commit.Hash.String()[:7])
   461→	return nil
   462→}
   463→
   464→// CanRewind checks if rewinding is possible.
   465→// For manual-commit strategy, rewind restores files from a checkpoint - uncommitted changes are expected
   466→// and will be replaced by the checkpoint contents. Returns true with a warning message showing
   467→// what changes will be reverted.
   468→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) CanRewind() (bool, string, error) {
   469→	return checkCanRewindWithWarning()
   470→}
   471→
   472→// PreviewRewind returns what will happen if rewinding to the given point.
   473→// This allows showing warnings about untracked files that will be deleted.
   474→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) PreviewRewind(point RewindPoint) (*RewindPreview, error) {
   475→	// Logs-only points don't modify the working directory
   476→	if point.IsLogsOnly {
   477→		return &RewindPreview{}, nil
   478→	}
   479→
   480→	repo, err := OpenRepository()
   481→	if err != nil {
   482→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
   483→	}
   484→
   485→	// Get the checkpoint commit
   486→	commitHash := plumbing.NewHash(point.ID)
   487→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   488→	if err != nil {
   489→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get commit: %w", err)
   490→	}
   491→
   492→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   493→	if err != nil {
   494→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get tree: %w", err)
   495→	}
   496→
   497→	// Load session state to get untracked files that existed at session start
   498→	sessionID, hasSessionTrailer := trailers.ParseSession(commit.Message)
   499→	var preservedUntrackedFiles map[string]bool
   500→	if hasSessionTrailer {
   501→		state, stateErr := s.loadSessionState(sessionID)
   502→		if stateErr == nil && state != nil && len(state.UntrackedFilesAtStart) > 0 {
   503→			preservedUntrackedFiles = make(map[string]bool)
   504→			for _, f := range state.UntrackedFilesAtStart {
   505→				preservedUntrackedFiles[f] = true
   506→			}
   507→		}
   508→	}
   509→
   510→	// Build set of files in the checkpoint tree (excluding metadata)
   511→	checkpointFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   512→	var filesToRestore []string
   513→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   514→		if !strings.HasPrefix(f.Name, entireDir) {
   515→			checkpointFiles[f.Name] = true
   516→			filesToRestore = append(filesToRestore, f.Name)
   517→		}
   518→		return nil
   519→	})
   520→	if err != nil {
   521→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to list checkpoint files: %w", err)
   522→	}
   523→
   524→	// Get HEAD tree to identify tracked files
   525→	head, err := repo.Head()
   526→	if err != nil {
   527→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD: %w", err)
   528→	}
   529→	headCommit, err := repo.CommitObject(head.Hash())
   530→	if err != nil {
   531→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD commit: %w", err)
   532→	}
   533→	headTree, err := headCommit.Tree()
   534→	if err != nil {
   535→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get HEAD tree: %w", err)
   536→	}
   537→
   538→	// Build set of files tracked in HEAD
   539→	trackedFiles := make(map[string]bool)
   540→	//nolint:errcheck // Error is not critical for preview
   541→	_ = headTree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   542→		trackedFiles[f.Name] = true
   543→		return nil
   544→	})
   545→
   546→	// Get repository root to walk from there
   547→	repoRoot, err := GetWorktreePath()
   548→	if err != nil {
   549→		repoRoot = "."
   550→	}
   551→
   552→	// Find untracked files that would be deleted
   553→	var filesToDelete []string
   554→	err = filepath.Walk(repoRoot, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, walkErr error) error {
   555→		if walkErr != nil {
   556→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Skip filesystem errors during walk
   557→		}
   558→
   559→		relPath, relErr := filepath.Rel(repoRoot, path)
   560→		if relErr != nil {
   561→			return nil //nolint:nilerr // Skip paths we can't make relative
   562→		}
   563→
   564→		// Skip directories and protected paths
   565→		if info.IsDir() {
   566→			if isProtectedPath(relPath) {
   567→				return filepath.SkipDir
   568→			}
   569→			return nil
   570→		}
   571→
   572→		// Skip files in protected directories
   573→		if isProtectedPath(relPath) {
   574→			return nil
   575→		}
   576→
   577→		// If file is in checkpoint, it will be restored (not deleted)
   578→		if checkpointFiles[relPath] {
   579→			return nil
   580→		}
   581→
   582→		// If file is tracked in HEAD, don't delete (user's committed work)
   583→		if trackedFiles[relPath] {
   584→			return nil
   585→		}
   586→
   587→		// If file existed at session start, preserve it (untracked user files)
   588→		if preservedUntrackedFiles[relPath] {
   589→			return nil
   590→		}
   591→
   592→		// File is untracked and not in checkpoint - will be deleted
   593→		filesToDelete = append(filesToDelete, relPath)
   594→		return nil
   595→	})
   596→	if err != nil {
   597→		// Non-fatal, return what we have
   598→		return &RewindPreview{ //nolint:nilerr // Partial result is still useful
   599→			FilesToRestore: filesToRestore,
   600→			FilesToDelete:  filesToDelete,
   601→		}, nil
   602→	}
   603→
   604→	// Sort for consistent output
   605→	sort.Strings(filesToRestore)
   606→	sort.Strings(filesToDelete)
   607→
   608→	return &RewindPreview{
   609→		FilesToRestore: filesToRestore,
   610→		FilesToDelete:  filesToDelete,
   611→	}, nil
   612→}
   613→
   614→// RestoreLogsOnly restores session logs from a logs-only rewind point.
   615→// This fetches the transcript from entire/checkpoints/v1 and writes it to the agent's session directory.
   616→// Does not modify the working directory.
   617→// When multiple sessions were condensed to the same checkpoint, ALL sessions are restored.
   618→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local logs have newer timestamps.
   619→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) RestoreLogsOnly(point RewindPoint, force bool) error {
   620→	if !point.IsLogsOnly {
   621→		return errors.New("not a logs-only rewind point")
   622→	}
   623→
   624→	if point.CheckpointID.IsEmpty() {
   625→		return errors.New("missing checkpoint ID")
   626→	}
   627→
   628→	// Resolve agent from checkpoint metadata (fall back to Claude for old checkpoints)
   629→	ag, err := resolveAgentForRewind(point.Agent)
   630→	if err != nil {
   631→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to resolve agent: %w", err)
   632→	}
   633→
   634→	// Get checkpoint store
   635→	store, err := s.getCheckpointStore()
   636→	if err != nil {
   637→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get checkpoint store: %w", err)
   638→	}
   639→
   640→	// Read checkpoint summary to get session count
   641→	summary, err := store.ReadCommitted(context.Background(), point.CheckpointID)
   642→	if err != nil {
   643→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to read checkpoint: %w", err)
   644→	}
   645→	if summary == nil {
   646→		return fmt.Errorf("checkpoint not found: %s", point.CheckpointID)
   647→	}
   648→
   649→	// Get repo root for agent session directory lookup
   650→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   651→	if err != nil {
   652→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repository root: %w", err)
   653→	}
   654→
   655→	sessionDir, err := ag.GetSessionDir(repoRoot)
   656→	if err != nil {
   657→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent session directory: %w", err)
   658→	}
   659→
   660→	// Ensure session directory exists
   661→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDir, 0o750); err != nil {
   662→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create agent session directory: %w", err)
   663→	}
   664→
   665→	// Check for newer local logs if not forcing
   666→	if !force {
   667→		sessions := s.classifySessionsForRestore(context.Background(), sessionDir, ag, store, point.CheckpointID, summary)
   668→		hasConflicts := false
   669→		for _, sess := range sessions {
   670→			if sess.Status == StatusLocalNewer {
   671→				hasConflicts = true
   672→				break
   673→			}
   674→		}
   675→		if hasConflicts {
   676→			shouldOverwrite, promptErr := PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions)
   677→			if promptErr != nil {
   678→				return promptErr
   679→			}
   680→			if !shouldOverwrite {
   681→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Resume cancelled. Local session logs preserved.\n")
   682→				return nil
   683→			}
   684→		}
   685→	}
   686→
   687→	// Count sessions to restore
   688→	totalSessions := len(summary.Sessions)
   689→	if totalSessions > 1 {
   690→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Restoring %d sessions from checkpoint:\n", totalSessions)
   691→	}
   692→
   693→	// Restore all sessions (oldest to newest, using 0-based indexing)
   694→	for i := range totalSessions {
   695→		content, readErr := store.ReadSessionContent(context.Background(), point.CheckpointID, i)
   696→		if readErr != nil {
   697→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: failed to read session %d: %v\n", i, readErr)
   698→			continue
   699→		}
   700→		if content == nil || len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   701→			continue
   702→		}
   703→
   704→		sessionID := content.Metadata.SessionID
   705→		if sessionID == "" {
   706→			// Fallback: can't identify session without ID
   707→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Warning: session %d has no session ID, skipping\n", i)
   708→			continue
   709→		}
   710→
   711→		agentSessionID := ag.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   712→		sessionFile := ag.ResolveSessionFile(sessionDir, agentSessionID)
   713→
   714→		// Get first prompt for display
   715→		promptPreview := ExtractFirstPrompt(content.Prompts)
   716→
   717→		if totalSessions > 1 {
   718→			isLatest := i == totalSessions-1
   719→			if promptPreview != "" {
   720→				if isLatest {
   721→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session %d (latest): %s\n", i+1, promptPreview)
   722→				} else {
   723→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  Session %d: %s\n", i+1, promptPreview)
   724→				}
   725→			}
   726→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Writing to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   727→		} else {
   728→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Writing transcript to: %s\n", sessionFile)
   729→		}
   730→
   731→		if writeErr := os.WriteFile(sessionFile, content.Transcript, 0o600); writeErr != nil {
   732→			if totalSessions > 1 {
   733→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "    Warning: failed to write transcript: %v\n", writeErr)
   734→				continue
   735→			}
   736→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to write transcript: %w", writeErr)
   737→		}
   738→	}
   739→
   740→	return nil
   741→}
   742→
   743→// resolveAgentForRewind resolves the agent from checkpoint metadata.
   744→// Falls back to the default agent (Claude) for old checkpoints that lack agent info.
   745→//
   746→
   747→func resolveAgentForRewind(agentType agent.AgentType) (agent.Agent, error) {
   748→	if !isSpecificAgentType(agentType) {
   749→		ag := agent.Default()
   750→		if ag == nil {
   751→			return nil, errors.New("no default agent registered")
   752→		}
   753→		return ag, nil
   754→	}
   755→	ag, err := agent.GetByAgentType(agentType)
   756→	if err != nil {
   757→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolving agent %q: %w", agentType, err)
   758→	}
   759→	return ag, nil
   760→}
   761→
   762→// readSessionPrompt reads the first prompt from the session's prompt.txt file stored in git.
   763→// Returns an empty string if the prompt cannot be read.
   764→func readSessionPrompt(repo *git.Repository, commitHash plumbing.Hash, metadataDir string) string {
   765→	// Get the commit and its tree
   766→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(commitHash)
   767→	if err != nil {
   768→		return ""
   769→	}
   770→
   771→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   772→	if err != nil {
   773→		return ""
   774→	}
   775→
   776→	// Look for prompt.txt in the metadata directory
   777→	promptPath := metadataDir + "/" + paths.PromptFileName
   778→	promptEntry, err := tree.File(promptPath)
   779→	if err != nil {
   780→		return ""
   781→	}
   782→
   783→	content, err := promptEntry.Contents()
   784→	if err != nil {
   785→		return ""
   786→	}
   787→
   788→	return ExtractFirstPrompt(content)
   789→}
   790→
   791→// SessionRestoreStatus represents the status of a session being restored.
   792→type SessionRestoreStatus int
   793→
   794→const (
   795→	StatusNew             SessionRestoreStatus = iota // Local file doesn't exist
   796→	StatusUnchanged                                   // Local and checkpoint are the same
   797→	StatusCheckpointNewer                             // Checkpoint has newer entries
   798→	StatusLocalNewer                                  // Local has newer entries (conflict)
   799→)
   800→
   801→// SessionRestoreInfo contains information about a session being restored.
   802→type SessionRestoreInfo struct {
   803→	SessionID      string
   804→	Prompt         string               // First prompt preview for display
   805→	Status         SessionRestoreStatus // Status of this session
   806→	LocalTime      time.Time
   807→	CheckpointTime time.Time
   808→}
   809→
   810→// classifySessionsForRestore checks all sessions in a checkpoint and returns info
   811→// about each session, including whether local logs have newer timestamps.
   812→func (s *ManualCommitStrategy) classifySessionsForRestore(ctx context.Context, sessionDir string, ag agent.Agent, store cpkg.Store, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, summary *cpkg.CheckpointSummary) []SessionRestoreInfo {
   813→	var sessions []SessionRestoreInfo
   814→
   815→	totalSessions := len(summary.Sessions)
   816→	// Check all sessions (0-based indexing)
   817→	for i := range totalSessions {
   818→		content, err := store.ReadSessionContent(ctx, checkpointID, i)
   819→		if err != nil || content == nil || len(content.Transcript) == 0 {
   820→			continue
   821→		}
   822→
   823→		sessionID := content.Metadata.SessionID
   824→		if sessionID == "" {
   825→			continue
   826→		}
   827→
   828→		agentSessionID := ag.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
   829→		localPath := ag.ResolveSessionFile(sessionDir, agentSessionID)
   830→
   831→		localTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromFile(localPath)
   832→		checkpointTime := paths.GetLastTimestampFromBytes(content.Transcript)
   833→		status := ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime)
   834→
   835→		sessions = append(sessions, SessionRestoreInfo{
   836→			SessionID:      sessionID,
   837→			Prompt:         ExtractFirstPrompt(content.Prompts),
   838→			Status:         status,
   839→			LocalTime:      localTime,
   840→			CheckpointTime: checkpointTime,
   841→		})
   842→	}
   843→
   844→	return sessions
   845→}
   846→
   847→// ClassifyTimestamps determines the restore status based on local and checkpoint timestamps.
   848→func ClassifyTimestamps(localTime, checkpointTime time.Time) SessionRestoreStatus {
   849→	// Local file doesn't exist (no timestamp found)
   850→	if localTime.IsZero() {
   851→		return StatusNew
   852→	}
   853→
   854→	// Can't determine checkpoint time - treat as new/safe
   855→	if checkpointTime.IsZero() {
   856→		return StatusNew
   857→	}
   858→
   859→	// Compare timestamps
   860→	if localTime.After(checkpointTime) {
   861→		return StatusLocalNewer
   862→	}
   863→	if checkpointTime.After(localTime) {
   864→		return StatusCheckpointNewer
   865→	}
   866→	return StatusUnchanged
   867→}
   868→
   869→// StatusToText returns a human-readable status string.
   870→func StatusToText(status SessionRestoreStatus) string {
   871→	switch status {
   872→	case StatusNew:
   873→		return "(new)"
   874→	case StatusUnchanged:
   875→		return "(unchanged)"
   876→	case StatusCheckpointNewer:
   877→		return "(checkpoint is newer)"
   878→	case StatusLocalNewer:
   879→		return "(local is newer)" // shouldn't appear in non-conflict list
   880→	default:
   881→		return ""
   882→	}
   883→}
   884→
   885→// PromptOverwriteNewerLogs asks the user for confirmation to overwrite local
   886→// session logs that have newer timestamps than the checkpoint versions.
   887→func PromptOverwriteNewerLogs(sessions []SessionRestoreInfo) (bool, error) {
   888→	// Separate conflicting and non-conflicting sessions
   889→	var conflicting, nonConflicting []SessionRestoreInfo
   890→	for _, s := range sessions {
   891→		if s.Status == StatusLocalNewer {
   892→			conflicting = append(conflicting, s)
   893→		} else {
   894→			nonConflicting = append(nonConflicting, s)
   895→		}
   896→	}
   897→
   898→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "\nWarning: Local session log(s) have newer entries than the checkpoint:\n")

+	}

+	agentSessionID := agent.ExtractAgentSessionID(sessionID)
+	return agent.ResolveSessionFile(agentSessionDir, agentSessionID), nil

   339→func findTranscriptForSession(sessionID, repoRoot string) (string, error) {

   481→// Always overwrites existing session logs to ensure consistency with checkpoint state.
   482→// If force is false, prompts for confirmation when local log has newer timestamps.
   483→func resumeSingleSession(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent, sessionID string, checkpointID id.CheckpointID, sessionDir, repoRoot string, force bool) error {

   504→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session '%s' found in commit trailer but session log not available\n", sessionID)

   506→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  %s\n", ag.FormatResumeCommand(agentSessionID))

   276→}

> AGENT

Here's a summary of the changes:

**Root cause**: When rewinding/resuming Gemini sessions, the transcript was written to the wrong directory. `GetSessionDir()` constructs the path using dash-replacement (`-Users-soph-...`) but Gemini actually stores files at SHA-256 hashed paths (`354ffe89...`). The correct path is stored in the session state's `transcript_path` field.

**Fix**: Added `resolveTranscriptPath()` / `resolveSessionFilePath()` helpers that check the session state's `transcript_path` first (populated from Gemini's hook data), falling back to `GetSessionDir()` + `ResolveSessionFile()` when session state isn't available.

**Files changed**:
- **`rewind.go`** - Added `resolveTranscriptPath()` helper, updated `writeTranscriptToAgentSession`, `restoreSessionTranscript`, and `restoreTaskCheckpointTranscript` to use it
- **`strategy/manual_commit_rewind.go`** - Added `resolveSessionFilePath()` helper, updated `RestoreLogsOnly` and `classifySessionsForRestore` to use it (with per-session `MkdirAll`)
- **`resume.go`** - Updated `resumeSingleSession` to use `resolveTranscriptPath()` with `MkdirAll` for parent directory
- **`debug.go`** - Updated `findTranscriptForSession` to use `resolveTranscriptPath()`

> AGENT

It's an artifact from the previous session's work. When I added `ResolveSessionFile()` to the agent interface, `SessionFileExtension()` became redundant — `ResolveSessionFile()` already handles the extension internally (`.jsonl` for Claude, `.json` for Gemini) along with the filename pattern.

It was likely added first as a building block, then `ResolveSessionFile()` subsumed its responsibility, and it was never cleaned up. Should I remove it?

+
+// ProtectedDirs returns directories that Gemini uses for config/state.
+func (g *GeminiCLIAgent) ProtectedDirs() []string { return []string{".gemini"} }
+
+// ResolveSessionFile returns the path to a Gemini session file.
+// Gemini names files as session-<date>-<shortid>.json where shortid is the first 8 chars
+// of the session UUID. This searches for an existing file matching the pattern, falling
+// back to <dir>/<id>.json if no match is found.
+func (g *GeminiCLIAgent) ResolveSessionFile(sessionDir, agentSessionID string) string {
+	// Try to find existing file matching Gemini's naming convention:
+	// session-*-<first8chars>.json
+	shortID := agentSessionID
+	if len(shortID) > 8 {
+		shortID = shortID[:8]
+	}
+
+	pattern := filepath.Join(sessionDir, "session-*-"+shortID+".json")
+	matches, err := filepath.Glob(pattern)
+	if err == nil && len(matches) > 0 {
+		// Return the most recent match (last alphabetically, since date is in the name)
+		return matches[len(matches)-1]
+	}
+
+	// Fallback: construct a default path
+	return filepath.Join(sessionDir, agentSessionID+".json")
+}
+
 // GetSessionDir returns the directory where Gemini stores session transcripts.
 // Gemini stores sessions in ~/.gemini/tmp/<project-hash>/chats/
 func (g *GeminiCLIAgent) GetSessionDir(repoPath string) (string, error) {
